summary: Bataan 2nd District representative with 90 principal-authored bills. Authored a right-to-information bill and two bills penalizing false information, plus local tax-share bills. One issue per dimension, so no dimension is scored. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Disinformation penalties (-) and FOI (+) sit in different dimensions, each a single issue.
